expectations.text: Rejects the app name 'Parcelwise Label Printer' on trademark naming-order grounds

expectations.text: Accepts option (b) and rejects option (a) as the description opener

expectations.text: States the rule as leading with the customer outcome rather than the feature's technical mechanism, and connecting each feature claim to a measurable result

expectations.text: Names keyword spam as a rejection trigger defined numerically - a stated repetition count, or lists of brands, sites, or regions adding no value - never as an unquantified 'do not stuff keywords'

expectations.text: Names unattributed or anonymous testimonials as their own rejection trigger

expectations.text: Flags the 'a warehouse manager in Ohio' quote specifically as failing attribution

expectations.text: Requires a publicly accessible landing page reachable without login

expectations.text: Requires a support channel with a stated response-time commitment
